verdict.rationale: Evidence shows a REST API, Connector SDK (Python), and MCP server, and even plugins for third-party AI CLIs (Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Copilot CLI) that add Fivetran-specific skills — but none of this is an official Fivetran-built CLI tool itself. No evidence of a native 'fivetran' command-line tool exists in the pack.
